state:
**Goal `ext-intl`: Stage 8, the feature proofs, is in progress.** Stages 1 to 7 are on disk: every export of `nvs:intl/icu` works, both components are embedded, and the growth test and the bundle test pass.

`Novis\Intl\Collator`, `Novis\Intl\NumberFormat` (all four members, `decimal` included), `Novis\Intl\PluralRules` and `Novis\Intl\RelativeTime` owe nothing: `bun nv proofs --verify --group '<Class>'` passes for each. Their Rust tests in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs` carry `covers:` markers, and the existing `.nvst` cases credit the Novis side by a plain call.

Still red: `Novis\Intl\ListFormat`, `Novis\Intl\Segmenter`, `Novis\Intl\DateFormat`, `Novis\Intl\Locale`, and `Novis\Intl\Icu`, the manifest class. Each has 1 of 2 cases (the Rust `covers:` marker is missing) and no about page, examples, attack or bench. The gate output names each owed path. `bun nv proofs --id` does not find a `Novis\` feature in any quoting, so use the group gate.

Each class is its own file set: `docs/examples/novis/Intl-<Class>/`, `tests/hostile/novis/Intl-<Class>/`, `benches/members/novis/Intl-<Class>/`, and a `// covers:` line above its Rust test. Copy the shape of `Intl-NumberFormat`. After the benches, run `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group '<Class>'`, then `bun nv proofs --comments` over the three trees.

items.text: **`Novis\Intl\ListFormat` and `Novis\Intl\Segmenter` owe nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): `join`, `words` and `sentences`. Source halves `extensions/intl/nvs/ListFormat.nvs:1` and `extensions/intl/nvs/Segmenter.nvs:1`; Rust tests `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs:795` and `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs:855`.

**`Novis\Intl\DateFormat` and `Novis\Intl\Locale` owe nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): `dateTimes`, `dates`, `times`, `negotiate` and `resolve`. Source halves `extensions/intl/nvs/DateFormat.nvs:1` and `extensions/intl/nvs/Locale.nvs:1`; Rust tests `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs:585` and `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs:957`.

**`Novis\Intl\Icu` owes nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): the manifest class's members, which the job classes call. Decide per member whether it owes its own proofs or a skip entry in `data/proofs/policy.json` naming the job class that carries them; the manifest is `extensions/intl/manifest.json:1`.

backlog: A five-number `NumberFormat`, `PluralRules` or `RelativeTime` call measures in the hundreds of microseconds (`docs/perf/members.ndjson`), far above the boundary's cost in `rule:packaging/the-boundary-is-the-cost`. One formatter is built per call (`extensions/intl/src/numbers.rs:1`); whether caching it per instance pays is not checked.
In a bench, a `? 1 : 3` ternary is `int` and does not add to a `uint` total (E0407); use an `if`.
